title: Oxygen-dependent elderly person, rising water

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: My mother uses oxygen at night. The water is rising in the lane.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Is the water inside the room yet?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Not inside. It is coming up the step. I am worried.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: How old is she, and can she walk?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: She is elderly. She cannot walk far without help.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Sung Men District, Phrae, near the invented blue temple. Please hurry.
